content:
Hi. My name is Mary.
Hello, Mary. I'm Michelle.
It's nice to meet you, Michelle.
Thank you. What do you want to do?
I have to go to class now.
Yeah. Me too. We'll meet later?
Yes. We can meet after school.
Okay. I'll see you then.
